text: 合肥城建公告，公司第八届董事会第三十八次会议审议通过《关于全资子公司拟发行中期票据的议案》，公司全资子公司工业科技拟发行总额不超过人民币8亿元（含8亿元）、期限不超过3年（含3年）的中期票据，募集资金主要用于偿还有息债务、补充流动资金、项目建设等。该议案尚需提交公司2026年第二次临时股东会审议。
text_en: Hefei Urban Construction announced that its 38th Board of Directors meeting approved a resolution on a wholly-owned subsidiary issuing medium-term notes. The subsidiary, Industrial Technology, plans to issue medium-term notes totaling no more than RMB 800 million (inclusive) with a term of no more than 3 years (inclusive), with proceeds mainly used to repay interest-bearing debt, replenish working capital, and fund project construction. The resolution is still subject to review at the company's second extraordinary shareholders' meeting in 2026.
